svg.title: svjeez
svg.desc: A sketchbook landing page printed in pink and blue riso ink on warm paper. 'hello,' is handwritten, then the letters of svjeez drop in, wobble and settle into register. A small yellow creature pops up on the z and blinks. A paper plane laps the page with a loop-the-loop, a sleepy sun turns, clouds drift and sparkles pop. Below, the tagline appears, npm i svjeez types in, and a pink marker circles it.

g.text: NO JAVASCRIPT · ONE FILE · PLAYS ANYWHERE
